claim_one_line: THE TWO EARLY CORRECTIONS RE-DERIVED (L243 (a); the audit lane's AR3 and AR4, carried into GENESIS by the SM seat). AR3: B37's self-model predicate any(component.has(I)) is False on every map written in x, y, z -- a detector that cannot fire (MB12; E82 class, 2026-05) -- so 'the trace map never reads kappa' is unsupported by B37's test; the audit lane's rewriting T' fires it while equal to T on the record graph; whether the map reads kappa in the reads-and-branches sense is FK12's, open. AR4: B130's inference 'empty k-elimination => kappa free => no choice' is invalid (V(x(x-1), xk) eliminates to nothing in k and has an isolated point), but B130's conclusion holds on its domain by a valid argument: at m = 2 two generators in three variables (Krull), and at m = 2, 3, 4 the primary decomposition has every component one-dimensional (2, 2, 4 curves, no point); the tombstone's 'isolated points' are singular points of curves.
